models_evaluated: ECG-based machine learning model (ECG-ML) for advanced chronic liver disease

links.outcome: New diagnosis of advanced CLD within 180 days, intervention vs usual care in cluster RCT
links.effect: Advanced CLD diagnoses 1.0% vs 0.5% overall (OR 2.09, 95% CI 1.22-3.55, P = 0.007); among ECG-ML-positive patients 4.4% vs 1.1% (OR 4.37).
links.quote: The intervention significantly increased new diagnoses of advanced CLD in the overall cohort (1.0% versus 0.5% in the control arm; odds ratio (OR) 2.09, 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.22-3.55, P = 0.007).

screen.reason: Pragmatic cluster-randomized trial evaluating the clinical deployment of an AI-ECG screening and alerting tool compared to usual care in primary care practice.
